title: Delegate request
description: A review or research task for a delegate model. Per-type rules (review needs criteria and source_of_truth) are checked by the harness.

workdir.description: Absolute path of the folder the delegate works in.

task.description: One line naming the task; names the run folder.

inputs.description: Paths the delegate reads itself, relative to workdir or absolute.

criteria.description: Review: what counts as a finding, most important first.

source_of_truth.description: Review: paths, or a phrase like "the code's own intended behaviour".

notes.description: Anything the other fields don't cover.

model.description: Requested model; the result records what ran.

request_key.description: Idempotency key: a repeat with the same key returns the existing run.
